A '''stun bayonet''' was a [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonet]] that was mounted on the end of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], allowing it to be used as a [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. It had a self-contained [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cell]] that allowed it to operate without draining any energy from the rifle's [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]]. It was generally used by military and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] organizations, as well as [[Elite Senate Guard]]s.<ref name="Galaxy at War Miniatures Preview 5" />

A stun bayonet detached from a rifle functioned as a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]].<ref name="Galaxy at War Miniatures Preview 5" />
